description: This Java source file defines the MyRssReader class, an Android Activity that loads an RSS reading interface, including a ListView populated with predefined RSS feed sources, and menu options for managing RSS feeds and service control.

classes.name: MyRssReader
classes.description: An Android Activity class that displays a list of RSS feeds and provides menu options to control RSS-related actions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and populates the ListView with RSS feed sources.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current state of the ListView selection before the activity is potentially killed.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates the options menu with actions related to RSS feeds and services.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares or updates the options menu before displaying it.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item clicks by showing alert messages corresponding to the selected action.
